lines.text: Jehu tells the people he will serve Baal a lot and summons all Baal's servants for a great sacrifice.
All of Baal's servants come, fill the temple from end to end, and receive lamps from the keeper of the wardrobe.
Jehu stations eighty men outside, and after the burnt offering the guards and officers kill the servants of Baal.
The men burn the sacred pillar and tear down the temple, and Jehu turns away from the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

wrong_details.wrong: Jehu turns away from the golden calves at Bethel and Dan
wrong_details.true: He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam, the worship of the golden calves at Bethel and Dan

lines.text: The LORD promises Jehu four generations of sons on the throne, and Jehu reigns twenty-eight years in Samaria before his son Jehoahaz succeeds him.
